verdict.rationale: Paperspace issues its own API keys for the REST API, JS SDK and CLI, and documents that keys have team-scoped permissions, with admins able to revoke other members' keys. Team scoping is a coarse boundary, not documented least-privilege control. Missing for 10: per-resource or per-action permission scopes (e.g. read-only or machine-only keys), key expiry/TTL, agent- or service-account-specific credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: If you are a team admin, you can also revoke keys that belong to other team members.
API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI).
